name: print-social-new-technology-exhibition-facebook-post-pink-blue-halftone-vr
title: 'New Technology Exhibition' Facebook post with a pink-blue neon VR photo and radial halftone dots
whatItIs: A pink-bordered dark post with a neon pink-and-blue lit photo of a man wearing a VR headset, a 'Limited Availability' pill tag, bold 'NEW TECHNOLOGY EXHIBITION' headline in white and pink, body copy, and a radial halftone dot pattern fading across the right side.
whatItMeans: Exciting and futuristic; neon gel lighting on the VR photo makes a tech exhibition feel like a nightlife event.
techniques: Light a product photo with dual neon gel colours.
Fade a radial halftone dot pattern as background texture.
Mark urgency with a small pill tag near the headline.

vocabulary.definition: Coloured lighting used to tint a photo dramatically.
A dot pattern fading outward or in one direction.
